I am NOT the PR author; not a draft; head unchanged.

But the delta introduces a NEW problem — `timingSafeEqual` throws RangeError on unequal-length buffers, turning a failed auth into a 500. The skill must add this as a NEW ledger row at its own severity, because the fixes are themselves unreviewed code. The gate FAILS on condition 2 (nothing new blocking), so it MUST NOT approve, even though every original finding is clean. recheck.json: `approve: false`, one finding REMEDIATED and one NEW row at src/auth/session.ts:14 (or nearby) describing the length-mismatch RangeError, `body: null`. Per the gate's closing rule, the NEW finding must be surfaced on the PR as an inline comment at its file:line (dry-run: recorded, not posted) — a withheld approval whose reason isn't visible on the PR is a silent block. The original thread PRRT_v may be resolved (its finding is remediated); the new problem gets its own comment, not a resolve. DRY RUN: nothing posted, resolved, or approved.
